summary: Resource teardown for a pointer-array struct, structurally related to MultiFieldPointerFree (00414380). Resets the text-format struct via TextFormatStructInitializer_4fe0, then runs two two-iteration countdown loops that free four pointer slots spaced at a 5-dword stride below the anchors this+23 and this+13, each slot freed only when non-null through FreeWrapper_7bcf. Finally frees the main pointer field at this+0 when non-null and returns its prior value. Invoked by GlobalListTripleCleanupWithTimerRemoval (00414210).

operations.description: Reset the text-format struct by calling TextFormatStructInitializer_4fe0 before any pointer-field teardown.
Two-iteration countdown loop from anchor this+23: each iteration loads the slot 5 dwords below the current anchor, frees it via FreeWrapper_7bcf when non-null, and steps the anchor down by 5.
Two-iteration countdown loop from anchor this+13: frees the two 5-dword-strided pointer slots below it when non-null.
Guard on the main pointer field at this+0: it is freed only when non-null.
Free the main pointer field at this+0 via FreeWrapper_7bcf when the guard passes.
Return the original main pointer value (null when the final free was skipped).
